violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register an employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2026

The Prep unit was observed held at an ambient temperature of 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items within the unit were evaluated and moved during the time of inspection. Establishment shall not use the unit to store TCS food items until it is able to maintain an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The prep unit located in the cookline area was observed unable to hold an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less and is not in good repair. Establishment is remove, repair, or repair unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register an employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is to call for service for unit. Establishment is to sanitize all dishes and utensils in the sanitizing basin of the 3-bay sink in the kitchen until the unit is repaired or replaced. Per PIC, parts were ordered and establishment is waiting for unit to be repaired. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

The Prep unit was observed held at an ambient temperature of 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items within the unit were evaluated and voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Establishment shall not use the unit to store TCS food items until it is able to maintain an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Rice was placed hot in covered containers. Food items shall remain uncovered until food items are completely cooled to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Food items were uncovered during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026

Sea scallops and fish filets was observed thawing on the counter. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Food items were placed into the refrigerator to finish thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
The 3-bay sink faucet in the kitchen area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/24/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register an employee certified in food safety with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. The ice machine was taken out of service during the time of inspection. Establishment is to clean, sanitize, and allow unit to air dry prior to returning to service. Ice was voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is to call for service for unit. Establishment is to sanitize all dishes and utensils in the sanitizing basin of the 3-bay sink in the kitchen until the unit is repaired or replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The Prep unit was observed held at an ambient temperature of 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items within the unit were evaluated and voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Establishment shall not use the unit to store TCS food items until it is able to maintain an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Pasta and soup were placed hot in the refrigerator in covered containers. Food items shall remain uncovered unit food items are completely cooled to 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Food items were uncovered during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025

The hand-washing sink in the bar area was blocked by chemical spray bottles located in the sink basin. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Spray bottles were removed from hand sink during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025

Molluscan Shellfish (little neck clams) located in the prep unit did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled with the name of chemicals during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2025
